description: Create a new SyncPen document. If a semantically similar document already exists, the response flags it — consider updating that one instead of creating a near-duplicate.

content.description: Initial markdown content for the document

folderId.description: Optional: Folder ID to place the document in

teamId.description: Optional: place the document in this team's space instead of personal — get the id from syncpen_list_teams.

name: syncpen_create
